name.en: Ayase defeats Ginji Okuma at the dojo

periods.summary: Escaped prisoner Ginji Okuma attacks Ayatsuji dojo to avenge his gang's defeat by Kaito fifteen years earlier. Kaito does not remember him and orders Ayase to capture him alone. Ayase overcomes Okuma's wind-based anti-counter techniques with Ten'i Muhou and Hidzume's wound expansion, defeating him.
periods.cause: Okuma uses the mass prison break to seek revenge on Kaito Ayatsuji, who once destroyed the Senzan-gumi.
periods.process: Okuma uses compressed air, Windburst Barrier and Claw Storm to counter Ayatsuji Ittou-ryuu's after-the-fact counters. Ayase defends until she can use a seamless attack, then expands a shallow wound into a disabling slash.
periods.outcome: Okuma is captured, and Ayase demonstrates growth from Ikki's corrections and Kaito's training.
periods.significance: Highlights Ayase's post-school-selection development and Kaito's role as teacher before Kuraudo's later duel.
